instruction: Can you disable the privacy/network interaction dialog? I don't want to be asked about network access every time.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
